mission: Property-test the mobile Result / Try Again state machine (apps/mobile) for stale-state bugs: repeated attempts, old clip reuse, wrong target inheritance, prior-result contamination, attempt sequencing.

method.framework: jest with deterministic seeded generators (mulberry32, fixed seeds, 300 randomized cases per property)
surfacesUnderTest: apps/mobile/src/components/strokeResultModel.ts (attemptChips, contactMarkerPresentation, contactHaloHalfWidthMs, phaseTimelinePresentation, strokeResultHeader, measuredRows, visibleMeasuredRows, isAbstainedResult)
properties: declared-null envelopes always re-arm AUTO; a prediction is never laundered into a declaration
the re-armed canonical always belongs to the declared stroke (no cross-technique inheritance)
handoff -> intent keeps canonical/slug registry-consistent; ambiguous slugs stay canonical-null
legacy rows (no envelope) re-declare exactly the analyzed shot, never a canonical
handoff lifecycle matches a single-slot reference model over random arm/peek/consume sequences
attempt chips: contiguous capture-order labels, exactly one current, permutation-invariant, later attempts never renumber earlier ones, null sessionId yields no chips
contact marker drawn iff estimated + (ball/paddle confirmation or confidence >= 0.6) + finite ms; halo finite and within [33, 165]ms; halo monotone non-increasing in confidence
phase timeline segments always positive-length, ordered, non-overlapping; anchor-free mode never draws a contact tick and always carries the motion-evidence caption
selector purity: interleaved A,B,A derivations identical to isolated A (no prior-result contamination via module state)
visibleMeasuredRows never drops or duplicates rows (visible + hiddenCount == total, prefix-stable)

violationsFound.property: the re-armed canonical always belongs to the declared stroke
violationsFound.reproduction: seed 0xe19_02; concrete case: strokeIntent { declaredStroke: 'volley', resolutionBasis: 'declared', resolvedProfileId: 'SERVE' } -> handoff.declaredCanonical === 'SERVE' -> techniqueIntentFromHandoff produced { canonical: 'SERVE', legacySlug: 'volley' }
violationsFound.impact: wrong target inheritance: a stored record whose resolvedProfileId does not correspond to its declaration (heterogeneous/corrupt persisted rows) re-armed the NEXT capture with another technique's canonical profile while keeping the declared slug — the zero-touch scoring gate would run with a contradictory canonical/slug pair
violationsFound.fix: apps/mobile/src/screens/tryAgainHandoff.ts: tryAgainFromResult now accepts resolvedProfileId only when SELECTABLE_TECHNIQUES_V1 maps that canonical to the exact declared legacySlug (canonicalMatchesSlug), replacing the membership-only SELECTABLE_CANONICALS check; otherwise canonical is honestly null and techniqueIntentFromHandoff falls back to the unambiguous-slug mapping
violationsFound.regressionTest: resultStateProps.test.ts: 'regression: a mismatched resolvedProfileId never seeds another technique's canonical'

violationsNotFound: All other 12 properties held over 300 seeded cases each (handoff lifecycle, AUTO re-arm honesty, attempt sequencing/permutation invariance, contact marker gate and halo bounds, phase timeline structure, selector purity, measured-row visibility).

gates.jest: npx jest in apps/mobile: 39 suites / 373 tests all pass (14 of them the new resultStateProps suite, ~3,900 randomized property cases; 359 pre-existing tests untouched and green)
gates.eslint: pnpm exec eslint on both touched files: clean (apps/mobile's own npm run lint script is broken at repo level — eslint.config.mjs resolves @eslint/js from the pnpm root, unrelated to this change)
gates.prettier: pnpm format:check at root: all files clean

datasetScope: none — no dataset records, labels, or held-out cases touched
